pages.text: Start by $(l:qcraft:basics/ore)mining Quantum Ore$(/l). Use its dust to make $(l:qcraft:basics/essences)essences$(/l), then $(l:qcraft:qblocks/observer_dependent)make a block that changes when you look at it$(/l).
pages.title: Your First Experiment

pages.text: Combine a Book and one Quantum Dust anywhere in a crafting grid. Finding dust unlocks this recipe.

$(l:qcraft:entanglement/pairing)Link two blocks$(/l) to share an observation. Put a $(l:qcraft:automation/randomness)random signal$(/l) on a wire. Then build two $(l:qcraft:computers/first_swap)stations that swap blocks$(/l).
